summary: Cavco Industries filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) announcing a $150 million stock repurchase program approved by its board on May 18, 2026. Purchases may be made in open market or privately negotiated transactions; no specific price, share count, or expiry date is set. The program is discretionary and can be suspended at any time; it will be funded by existing cash. The filing also contained fiscal Q4 and FY2026 earnings results. The buyback announcement is a non-binding capital return authorization. Watch for actual execution pace as a signal of management's view on undervaluation. There is no risk-arb angle as this is not an M&A event.
